links.x: GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is the developer. The airport is at Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, costs over ₹5,640 crore and has a capacity of about 60 lakh (6 million) passengers per year.
JSW’s integrated steel plant is at Kadapa; the KIA plant is at Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district (earlier Anantapur), Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the DRDO AMCA centre at Puttaparthi.
